overrides.title: Practices for body, breath and the busy mind.
overrides.lead: Group classes most days of the week, workshops once a month and private coaching when you want someone in your corner.

overrides.title: Choose your pace.
overrides.lead: All sessions are taught in English and Dutch, with options for injuries, pregnancy and first-timers.

overrides.title: Six weeks, one person, a real plan.
overrides.body1: Coaching starts with a free 15-minute call. If we are a fit, we meet weekly — in the studio or online — and build a plan around sleep, stress and energy.
overrides.body2: Programmes are €420 for six sessions, including a personalised practice recording and messages between calls.

seo.title: Classes & coaching — Grove
seo.description: Yoga, yin, breathwork and 1:1 coaching at Grove. See the weekly timetable, memberships and private programmes.
